                <p class="text-center">Principal</p>


                Principal

Principal It is a matter of immense pleasure for me to welcome you all to the website of Govt College for Girls, Nacholi Faridabad. The college is about to complete 6 years of establishment and has 646 students in different courses of Graduation. We all dedicate ourselves to provide quality education to the student of this area. As principal of this institution, my first priority is to ensure the regularity of classes and active participation of the students in academic, cultural, and sports activities for their all-around development. The Students of the college have won the top positions in various inter-college and State level cultural, sports and creative competitions. All the staff members of the college are committed to inculcate the feeling of National integration, National pride, International awareness, intellectual development, justice, freedom, equality and brotherhood among the students to make them responsible citizen of our Nation. We are determined to retain this level of superiority already in command and improve further in the sphere of academic, cultural and sports activities. The institution has achieved so many feathers to its crown during the last few years. The efforts collectively made by the staff to reach this success are commendable. New Education policy 2020 aims at giving equal emphasis on all the subjects-science, arts, languages, sports, mathematics with integration of vocational and academic streams in schools and colleges. The college is determined to follow NEP 2020. I wish you a very happy and academically highly rewarding student life at Govt. College for Girls, Nacholi Faridabad and hope that you will enhance the pride and prestige of this esteemed institution by your brilliant performance in every sphere of your life
